plan.summary: This 1-4 block is an off-camp boxing strength and power build that stays compact enough to fit around higher sparring load. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the primary lifts so percentage work can start cleanly in Week 2. Weeks 2-3 build force and power with low exercise count, fast intent, and recoverable volume. Week 4 deloads by cutting volume while keeping the main patterns and speed work in place. Review how recovery, sparring quality, and bar speed felt at the end of Week 4 before the next block.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Establish baselines, build general strength, and keep crisp power work present without adding unnecessary fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Push the key lifts and throws forward while keeping volume tight enough to recover alongside boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift more of the work toward fast power and sharp output while holding onto the strength built earlier.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Reset between reps and jump as high and fast as possible. Land softly and stop if height drops.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a box height you can land on cleanly without tucking hard.

exercises.name: 2. Back Squat
